Files in this directory (hand_simulation.cpp/.h, vrmath.h, controller_device_driver.cpp, README.md) are from
ValveSoftware/openvr, samples/drivers (handskeletonsimulation, utils/vrmath), fetched 2026-10-10 from the

compiled into driver_framehands; controller_device_driver.cpp is kept for reference.
